name: hermes-bot-mode
description: Desktop plugin for Hermes Agent — roster of named bots with avatars, cron, and bot-to-bot messaging

scripts.lint: eslint . --ext .js,.mjs || echo "eslint not installed — run npm install"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --allowJs --checkJs --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --strict false plugin.js groups.mjs || true
